'''Dave Nicpon''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 6th at [[2000 Illinois State Championship]] on 1 April 2000 with Big Blue (Defensive Perimeter start), according to Eric Olson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d452">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-illinois-championship-normal-4-1-2000d452/ illinois-championship-normal-4-1-2000], DeckTech (Eric "Grimnok" Olson, 3 April 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-04-03-illinois-championship-normal-4-1-2000d452/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
